| [CASE-207](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-207.md) v2 | The square twist: a crease pattern with no rigid folding motion folds once facet bending is paid for, so which configurations are connected depends on the energy available | Filed at the owner's request on 2026-11-05, to file "one or more CASEs for origami as a toy model of a resource bounded constraint configuration space". Silverberg et al. 2015 ([NOTE-1554](../../../record/notes.d/NOTE-1554.md)): the square twist's crease pattern is isostatic, and rigidly it has only two isolated states, unfolded and folded, yet it folds by bending its facets, a hidden degree of freedom with its own energy scale. The authors' thesis is that the number of degrees of freedom changes with the energy scale probed; their kinematic skeleton, with bending capped at 10°, has a critical plane angle near 23° separating a connected configuration space from a disconnected one. Read as a resource model, the configuration space is indexed by the budget rather than fixed, and widening the admissible moves is itself priced, which joins the vertex under a budget ([CASE-206](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-206.md)) to the curved vertex whose moves no budget widens ([CASE-204](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-204.md)). A mechanical study; its organizational reading is an analogy. Adopting it is the owner's call. | Proposed |

Jules et al. ([NOTE-1617](../../../record/notes.d/NOTE-1617.md)) show the same dependence on the order of thresholds in a Kresling memory. | [CASE-313](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-313.md) | Removing the core of Ito and Kaneko's coupled-map network: in 12 of 12 seeds the periphery refills it to its former size and one-way structure within a million steps; half a core removed is made up from the periphery; a core made rare in influence is recovered by its own members | [LEAD-065](../../../record/leads.d/LEAD-065.md) asked whether [QUESTION-132](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-132.md)'s candidate case, Ito and Kaneko's network of identical logistic maps with normalized, similarity-reinforced weights ([LIT-1842](../../../record/literature.d/LIT-1842.md), [NOTE-1414](../../../record/notes.d/NOTE-1414.md)), refills its core when core units are removed. The model was reimplemented at the paper's parameters (N = 100, a = 3.97, c = 0.12, δ = 0.1) and grown for 3 × 10⁶ steps in 12 seeds. It reproduces a core of 15.6 ± 1.2 units by the paper's snapshot criterion, and 18.2 ± 1.1 by time-averaged outgoing weight above the mean, with 1.6 ± 2.6 periphery-to-core links (paper: 2). Five arms then ran for 10⁶ steps. With the whole core deleted, former periphery units formed a new core of 17.2 ± 0.8 units. The control that deletes as many periphery units formed one of 17.0 ± 1.1. The new core had 2.9 ± 4.8 periphery-to-core links. With a random half of the core deleted, 8.8 ± 0.8 periphery units joined the 8.5 survivors. With every weight given to the core cut to 10⁻³ of its value, the core's own members made up 92% of the core 10⁶ steps later. The differentiation recovers. | [CASE-315](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-315.md) | A readiness simulator run under spend-matching and under carry-over: a heavy rescue squad whose budget is set to the last month's peak is lost for good in every run within months where it is sent only on confirmation, in a fifth of runs within nine years where it is sent provisionally to each of six reports a month, and never where it drills each month or the unspent budget rolls over | [LEAD-080](../../../record/leads.d/LEAD-080.md) asked for A's simulator of [QUESTION-394](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-394.md) to be run twice, once with each month's budget set to the last month's peak spending ([CLAIM-577](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-577.md)) and once with carry-over, to see whether the heavy-rescue response of [CASE-213](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-213.md) stays reachable. | [CASE-322](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-322.md) | Checking a restricted theorem on differentiated, recoverable specialists numerically: the recovery bound holds in 7,981 random removals, with equality whenever no other component goes extinct; Gaussian-niche operators started almost identical differentiate to equilibria meeting the stability conditions; and in a two-resource trade-off a removed specialist fails to return exactly where the lone resident leaves its corner for a generalist that takes more than its share | The numerical check of [CLAIM-885](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-885.md) and [CLAIM-886](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-886.md), [LEAD-049](../../../record/leads.d/LEAD-049.md)'s theorem and counterexample. The measure is Barrett and Seth's autoregressive integrated information (Phi_AR) at the minimum information bipartition, computed exactly for linear Gaussian networks; the rule is IIT's exclusion postulate, which makes the candidate of largest Phi the subject and denies it to what it contains or is contained in. The mind is three modules of three units; the group is three such minds, each unified by the rule, built the same way one level up. Sweeping the coupling between parts, the whole wins in both models once coupling across its seams passes a threshold, and its parts lose; below it, the parts win.
